hooks.name: Block destructive git commands
hooks.description: Blocks destructive git commands (force push, reset --hard, clean -f, branch -D, rebase) to prevent irreversible history changes.

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$input | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object { $cmd = $_.toolInput.command; if ($cmd -match '(?i)(push\s+--force|reset\s+--hard|clean\s+-f|branch\s+-D|rebase|force-push)') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine(\"BLOCKED: Destructive git command detected: '$cmd'. Use non-destructive alternatives or get explicit user confirmation first.\"); exit 2 } else { exit 0 } }"
